subject: CloudRetailer marketplace procurement & PO intake — vendor checklist and next steps
messages:
From: Sienna Patel <sienna@cloudretailer.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudretailer.com
Date: 2026-11-13T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding + PO process for CloudRetailer marketplace listing

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — procurement is ready to move forward with Redwood for our marketplace listing. We need to get vendor setup and PO intake completed so we can approve spend and schedule the listing window. Can you send a single checklist/document that covers: vendor intake form, tax or W-9 requirements, SOC2/evidence needs, marketplace listing prerequisites (AWS / GCP / Azure), and the PO process you require for Net30 terms?

Procurement-specific asks:
- We’ll provide a PO (PO-CR-4567) and need Redwood to confirm it can be applied to monthly consolidated invoices.
- We require a DocuSign order form for signature.
- Please confirm the contact for billing and the expected lead time between PO receipt and billing activation.

Goal: go-live on the marketplace by Nov 30 if vendor setup and legal review are complete. Is that timeline realistic?

Attachments: none in this email — procurement will attach the PO once we confirm form/flow.

Best,
Sienna Patel
Head of Marketplace Ops
CloudRetailer
sienna@cloudretailer.com
From: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Sienna Patel <sienna@cloudretailer.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + PO process for CloudRetailer marketplace listing

Hi Sienna — thanks, appreciate the clear asks. Put together the intake checklist below and attached the intake form + evidence matrix. Short answers inline:

Vendor intake checklist (attached: vendor_intake_form.pdf)
- Signed vendor intake form (please complete and return)
- Tax form: W-9 for US entities (or W-8 for non-US) — attach to the intake form
- Evidence: redwood_evidence_matrix.xlsx lists common artifacts (SOC 2 report, encryption attestations, data flow diagrams). SOC2 Type II preferred for production marketplace listings.
- Marketplace prerequisites:
  - AWS Marketplace: we need an AMS listing owner from your side + SKU/pricing matrix; AWS requires specific product codes — we’ll map on our side after SKU draft.
  - GCP Marketplace: requires containerized listing + billing account mapping — please confirm if you want prorated or flat monthly listing.
  - Azure Marketplace: accept managed listing docs; legal review needed for commercial marketplace terms.
- PO process and terms: we accept standard PO references on invoices; Net30 is supported. Please include PO number on the invoice and confirm remit details (below).

Billing remit (what we need on the PO)
- Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit to: invoices@redwood.ai
- Tax ID: 12-3456789
- Bill-to address: Redwood Inference, 450 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105

Can you return the completed intake form + W-9 and attach the PO when ready? I included a temporary DocuSign order form link for the order: https://docusign.com/redwood/cr-orderform-2026 (placeholder)

I’m looping Ben for billing mapping and Vanessa for marketplace ops handoff. Once we have the intake packet and PO we’ll: legal review (3 business days typical), billing activation (2 business days after PO + W-9), and listing kickoff (2 weeks for initial SKU and sandbox work).

Next steps:
1) You: complete vendor_intake_form.pdf + attach W-9 + upload PO-CR-4567.pdf
2) We: confirm billing account, process DocuSign order form, and schedule marketplace kickoff meeting (I’ll propose times).

Cheers,
Aisha Rahman
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
aisha@redwood.ai
From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sienna Patel <sienna@cloudretailer.com>, aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-14T08:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + PO process for CloudRetailer marketplace listing

Hi Sienna — quick note from billing side. A couple of practical items that speed PO processing:

1) Please attach a completed W-9 and indicate whether you require a consolidated monthly invoice (sounds like you do). We can map a single invoice per month with PO reference.
2) If the purchase is routed through AWS Marketplace or GCP Marketplace, the invoice routing differs: AWS may require Marketplace fees to be invoiced differently (marketplace take rate vs Redwood subscription). Tell us which marketplaces will be used so we can set the correct invoice templates.
3) What’s the expected monthly run-rate or commit? That helps with seat/usage SKU mapping and prevents rework on invoice lines.

Attached: billing_mapping_template.csv for the SKU/charge breakdown we prefer returned with PO or during kickoff.

If you want, we can accept the PO and start billing activation while legal completes the order form signature — we typically hold provisioning until the order form is countersigned if it contains billing commitments.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of FinOps (Marketplace Billing)
Redwood Inference
From: Sienna Patel <sienna@cloudretailer.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + PO process for CloudRetailer marketplace listing

Thanks Aisha and Ben — attaching our PO and the procurement stub.

Attachments:
- PO-CR-4567.pdf (official PO)
- CR-tax-w9.pdf (our W-9)

We will list on AWS and GCP initially (no Azure for now). Consolidated monthly invoice is preferred; Net30 is standard for us. Expected spend is approx $8k/month initially, ramping to ~$25k over 3 months depending on usage.

Procurement expects a DocuSign order form with the PO number pre-populated; can Redwood send a pre-filled order form for signature? If so, route to procurement@cloudretailer.com.

Go-live target: Nov 30 still preferable — but if legal review pushes beyond that we can be flexible into early December.

Onboarding contacts for marketplace work:
- Sienna Patel, Head of Marketplace Ops — sienna@cloudretailer.com
- Procurement: procurement@cloudretailer.com

Let me know if you need anything else to process the PO.

Best,
Sienna
From: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding + PO process for CloudRetailer marketplace listing

Hi Sienna / Procurement team — received PO-CR-4567 and W-9, thanks. Quick summary and confirmed timeline:

1) Legal review of the order form: we’ll generate a pre-filled DocuSign (link will be sent to procurement@cloudretailer.com) — target 48–72 hours for standard review, unless legal requests edits.
2) Billing activation: once DocuSign is signed and W-9 is on file, FinOps (Ben) will enable consolidated monthly invoicing and link the PO to the billing profile (2 business days).
3) Marketplace kickoff: Vanessa will own marketplace ops and will schedule a 60-minute kickoff to finalize SKUs, sandbox credentials, and listing artifacts. Target kickoff by Nov 23 so we can push to a late-Nov/early-Dec go-live.

Open items for you before kickoff:
- Confirm which SKU model you prefer (usage-based vs flat monthly subscription) for the initial listing — Ben’s template will help map this.
- Provide any required commerce tax jurisdiction info for invoicing.

I’m attaching the evidence matrix and billing mapping template for convenience. If everything above looks good I’ll kick the DocuSign flow now and Vanessa will send calendar invites for the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to getting CloudRetailer live.

Regards,
Aisha Rahman
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
